newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Cardiosystems to offer debentures.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Cardiosystems to offer debentures.

text.p: Thermo Cardiosystems Inc said on Friday it has agreed to sell at par $70 million of 4-3/4 percent subordinated debentures due 2004.
The debentures will be convertible into shares of common stock at a price of $31.415.

The company intends to use the net proceeds of the offering, estimated to be approximately $68 million, to repurchase its own common stock, for working capital and other general corporate purposes, Thermo Cardiosystems said.
The debentures are guaranteed on a subordinated basis by Thermo Electron Corp, Thermo Cardiosystems said.
The company expects to close the offering on May 14, 1997, it said.
